findings.title: Checkout and order confirmation do not exist yet — the demo flow stops at Buy

evidence.quote: Checkout screen ("Buy with protection"), opened from **Buy** on a green or yellow listing
**Pay** → order created, status "Paid · waiting for the seller"; confirmation screen
Buy with protection (mobile and desktop)

findings.proposal: Build story 7 next (it is in progress): checkout from Buy, Pay, and a confirmation screen. These close the demo flow search → buy.

resolution.decision: Built in story 7 (d648e9e). Checked on .ux-review/shots/checkout-375/1280.png and order-confirmation-375/1280.png; both match the designs, apart from the recorded decisions (€2.00 fee, address typed, MB WAY label only).

findings.title: No screen for 'Sorry, this record was just sold'

evidence.quote: Listing sold while the buyer is on the checkout → "Sorry, this record was just sold" and no order is created

findings.proposal: Build it with the checkout: same layout as the error screen, with a way back to the listings.

resolution.decision: Built in story 7: the message replaces Pay and offers 'See other listings'; the typed address stays. Checked on .ux-review/shots/checkout-just-sold-375/1280.png.

findings.title: Saved ranking for signed-in buyers is not built (story 2, phase 2)

evidence.quote: Signed-in buyer **with a saved ranking**: the screen is **skipped**; the recommendation shows "Based on: Price, Sound · **Change**"
**Purchase:** stories 9 (sign-up, log in), 7, 2 (save to account)

findings.question: Story 2 phase 2 is in the Purchase phase, after story 7. Keep it before the demo, or move it to 'if time allows'?

findings.title: Selling is not built: no 'Sell for free' in the header and none of the five sell screens

evidence.quote: **"Sell for free"** in the header; requires login (story 9)
Sell a record (mobile and desktop)
**None yet: Canva design needed before building**

evidence.where: How we build a story, step 1b
evidence.quote: Every new screen the story needs has an approved design (in docs/design/ or a Canva link in the story's "Designs" section). Without it, the story does not start.

findings.proposal: Story 8 cannot start yet: three of its screens (pick a version, first-time city/shop, My listings) have no design. Approve those three designs first, then build: pick version, form, first-time details, My listings, and the 'not in our catalogue' message.

findings.title: On desktop most screens are a narrow phone column in the middle of a wide empty page

evidence.quote: Desktop layouts use two columns: cover beside the options, photos beside the checklist, results in a grid

findings.proposal: Use two columns from 1024 px where the design does: priorities (cover left, 2 × 2 options right), listing check (photos left, checklist and Buy right). The recommendation already does this well.

findings.title: Desktop header: logo centred and 'Log in' pinned to the window edge, outside the content width

evidence.quote: Logo left, then search, 'Sell for free' and the account button, all inside the page width
Logo on the left, inside the page width, with a thin line under the header

findings.proposal: Put the logo on the left and 'Log in' / initials on the right inside the same max width as the content; leave room for 'Sell for free' (story 8).

findings.title: Traffic-light colours are generic bright green, amber and red, not the design palette

evidence.quote: Match #2F7A45 · Check #E9B44C · No match #A3302A
bg-green-600 · bg-amber-400 · bg-red-600

findings.proposal: Add the three palette colours to globals.css and use them in TrafficLight; the words stay as they are.

findings.title: The listing check verdict is a small chip; the design makes it a dark-brown emphasis card

evidence.quote: 'Check first' card: dark brown, traffic light, one-line summary
dark brown for emphasis cards

findings.proposal: Turn the summary box into the dark-brown card (light + word + summary). It is the answer to the screen's question, so it should be the strongest element.

findings.title: Checklist rows read as contradictions: 'Matrix photo matches — Uncertain', 'Country and year match — Doesn't match'

evidence.quote: The matrix photo **isn't sharp**

findings.proposal: Word each row by its result, e.g. ✓ 'Country and year match', ? 'Matrix photo: can't be sure', ✗ 'Country and year don't match'. Would need a small story 5 text change; show current vs proposed first.

findings.title: A red listing says 'moved to 1990 Reissue' but gives no way to go there

evidence.quote: appears here as a warning and also under the **correct version**

findings.question: Should 'moved to 1990 Reissue' link to that version's listings? It is not in story 5 today.

findings.title: Log in and sign-up have no back button and no 'Just browsing?' line

evidence.quote: back arrow · 'Just browsing? You can search and get recommendations without an account.'

findings.proposal: Add the back button used on the other screens and the 'Just browsing?' line under the form. (The 'Show' password button is optional.)

findings.title: 'Your account' has no loading.tsx / error.tsx, unlike the other data screens

evidence.quote: Loading and errors always use the shared `LoadingMask` and `ErrorScreen`.
LogOutButton.tsx · actions.ts · page.tsx

findings.proposal: Add loading.tsx (LoadingMask) and error.tsx (ErrorScreen with 'Try again') to app/account, as in the other routes.

findings.title: Buy sits on its own row under each listing, leaving an empty column and making rows tall

evidence.quote: Buy on the same line as the price and the traffic light

findings.proposal: Put Buy on the right of the row, beside the traffic light, on desktop; on phone keep it but reduce the gap.

findings.title: Pay is greyed out with no word on what is missing

evidence.quote: disabled actions explain why, or what is missing is visible

findings.proposal: Under the greyed-out Pay button, show one line until the address is complete, e.g. "Fill in your address to pay". The wording is yours to choose; it would go in DECISIONS.md like the other build-time texts.

findings.title: The 'Shop' tag drops onto its own line, slightly indented, after the city

evidence.quote: the "Shop" tag keeps story 9's criterion

findings.proposal: Put the tag right after the shop name ("Discos do Rui [Shop], Lisboa") so it stays on the same line as the name and no longer starts a new line with a gap in front.

questions.question: Story 2 phase 2 is in the Purchase phase, after story 7. Keep it before the demo, or move it to 'if time allows'?
Should 'moved to 1990 Reissue' link to that version's listings? It is not in story 5 today.
